title: The honest ladder
blurb: Mate in two when every claim can be called.
say: Black still has chips, so any lie you tell can be called and caught. Your cards on a1 and b1 are both rooks. Checkmate in two moves.
explain: Claim Rook honestly and cut off the seventh rank with b7. The black king can only step to g8, then the other rook mates on a8. If Black calls either claim, the card flips face up as a rook and Black pays for it.
hint: First take away the seventh rank, then use the eighth.
